title: The universe may be hiding conscious minds stranger than we can imagine

Drawing on the vastness of the universe and the likely existence of countless alien civilizations, they suggest it would be surprisingly Earth-centric to assume that only Earth-like biology can support conscious experience.

title: Scientists discover hidden “footprints of death” that may help viruses spread

But researchers found that influenza viruses can exploit this process, hiding inside these microscopic packages and potentially using them to spread to nearby cells.

title: Why South Africa’s leopards shrank to half their normal size

Surprisingly, despite their small population, they have retained much of their genetic diversity.

title: Early humans were bringing fire into caves 1.8 million years ago

The discovery pushes back the timeline for fire use and reveals surprisingly sophisticated behavior long before humans could create fire on demand.
